hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains in the ICU in Brasília suffering from intestinal obstruction and broncopneumonia. Supporters are organizing prayer vigils outside the hospital while Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes issued specific authorizations for lawyer visits amid ongoing political infighting within the Bolsonarista movement.
hotspots.affect: The health crisis of the right-wing leader triggers intense emotional mobilization among evangelical and loyalist bases alongside sharp political tension over legal oversight.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox is making its final campaign push ahead of the November 29 elections, centering its rhetoric on anti-immigration, lower taxes, and direct clashes with the ruling Socialists. The campaign has sparked fiery debates across Spanish regional and national media over potential PP-Vox coalition scenarios and controversial campaign billboards.
hotspots.affect: High electoral anxiety and aggressive anti-establishment messaging generate intense polarized contention across the Spanish political landscape.

hotspots.title: Péter Magyar Meets Zelenskyy in Historic Transcarpathian Summit
hotspots.blurb: Tisza Party leader Péter Magyar traveled to Uzhhorod and Beregszász to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, joint-laying wreaths at fallen soldiers' graves and discussing humanitarian aid and EU integration. The summit sparked immediate counter-attacks from Fidesz allies and German AfD figures who accused Magyar of acting as a globalist puppet.
hotspots.affect: Unprecedented high-level diplomacy by Hungary's main opposition leader directly challenges Orbán's foreign policy narrative, fueling intense partisan accusations and patriotic framing.

hotspots.title: Swedish Government Crisis & SD Coalition Negotiations
hotspots.blurb: Swedish Moderate leader Ulf Kristersson is preparing for a parliamentary vote to form a four-party government after opposition leader Magdalena Andersson conceded her attempt. The Sweden Democrats (SD) under Jimmie Åkesson hold crucial leverage, while Centre Party internal splits complicate coalition stability.
hotspots.affect: High political stakes and brinkmanship over far-right influence in government drive intense media scrutiny and party-line anxiety.

hotspots.title: Trump Backlash Over Reinstating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump's executive intervention overriding Nvidia's board to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang—and suggesting a U.S. government equity stake—continues to draw sharp criticism. Senator Marco Rubio raised national security concerns while both MAGA loyalists and opponents debate potential conflicts of interest.
hotspots.affect: Rare internal friction within the conservative coalition and corporate governance alarm create a notable spike in charged coverage.
